h2.span: 1. Why: What Happened Last Time & Why This Project Exists

span.span: 为什么做：Sushi Day 复盘结论与项目缘起

p.strong: What worked & what didn't (202608 Sushi Day):

ul.li: Overall penetration rose +5.7pp in 5 weeks (8.89% → 14.56%) — but high-AOV user penetration was the lowest of all tiers: only 8.58% → 12.09% 大盘渗透率 5 周 +5.7pp（8.89% → 14.56%）——但高 AOV 用户渗透率仅 8.58% → 12.09%，是各分层中最低的：我们的高价值用户被"低价锚点"挡在了活动之外
High-preference merchants (the ones our high-AOV users actually love) were under-recruited. Core blocker: no discounted dishes on menu 高偏好商户（高 AOV 用户真正喜欢的商户）招商覆盖率最低。核心卡点：商家菜单上没有折扣菜

Merchants that joined actually LOST volume after the campaign: Ai Sushi (-27%), Nagoya Temakeria (-17.8%), Guigoboro (-12%) — campaign resources never reached their core high-AOV customers 参与活动的商户活动后反而掉量：Ai Sushi（-27%）、Nagoya Temakeria（-17.8%）、Guigoboro（-12%）——活动资源没有触达他们的核心高 AOV 客群
51.4% of high-AOV sushi orders contain 2+ items — multi-item combos are a natural demand Sushi 高 AOV 订单中 51.4% 购买 2 件及以上——组合购买是天然需求

km-doc.p: A September Santos initiative: a Sushi High-Quality Zone (Keeta Premier Zone). We co-build a premium supply with merchants via discounted dishes + Keeta-exclusive combo deals. Merchants get "slots & traffic", not a one-way discount squeeze. 9 月桑托斯专项：打造 Sushi 高品质专区（Keeta Premier Zone）。通过"折扣菜 + Keeta 独家组合套餐"两大供给与商家共建品质阵地。商家拿到的是"名额与流量"，而不是单向让利。

span.span: 目标：10 家商户，数字明确

p.span: ≥6 per merchant @ 40%off+ (priority: hot items with original price > R$75) 每家 ≥6 个，40%off+（优先原价 > R$75 的热销品）
6 new Keeta-exclusive combos 新增 6 个 Keeta 独家套餐
First 2 merchants signed + 2 exclusive combos (BDM-led) 先签 2 家 + 2 个独家套餐（BDM 和管理塔带头攻坚）

km-doc.p: Why high-preference merchants are the gap: in the last campaign funnel, high-preference × mid/low-volume merchants had 0–20% acquisition coverage — the structural hole this project fills. 为什么高偏好商户是缺口： 上期招商漏斗中，"高偏好 × 中/低单量"商户招商覆盖率仅 0–20%——这正是本项目要补的结构性洼地。

km-doc.p: We upgrade door-to-door discount negotiations into an invitation-only premium zone. Only merchants meeting the quality bar get in. The platform gives traffic & badges; merchants give discounted dishes & exclusive combos. 把逐户"要折扣菜"的谈判，升级为邀请制高品质专区招商：只有满足品质供给标准的商户才能入驻。平台给流量和标签，商家给折扣菜和独家套餐——双向奔赴。

km-doc.p: If September works, the model replicates to other categories (Burger, Pizza...) — building Keeta's premium mindshare asset in Santos.

ol.li: Profit first: post-combo merchant margin ≥ single-item level 利润优先：组合后毛利率不低于正常单品水平
AOV fit: target paid AOV R$80–120 (high-AOV sushi cohort AOV = R$91.6) AOV 匹配：目标实付 AOV R$80–120（Sushi 高 AOV 人群 AOV = R$91.6）
Combo form: hot dish + drink/side; more pieces, lower perceived per-piece price — matches the "51.4% buy ≥2 items" pattern 组合形态：热销菜+饮料/小食；件数多、单件感知价低，匹配"51.4% 买 ≥2 件"

km-doc.p: How to sell exclusivity 独家性谈法： we do NOT ask for merchant-level exclusivity (exclusivity agreements are hard to sign). We ask for combo-level Keeta first launch / exclusivity — the combo only exists on Keeta, not on iFood. Fallback if merchant balks: remove platform subsidy + remove from zone. 不谈"商户独家"（排他协议难签），谈"套餐 Keeta 首发/独家"——组合只在 Keeta 有，iFood 不上同款。降级方案：取消平台补贴 + 专区下线。

p.strong: Merchant contribution requirement 招商目标 — 40% merchant-funded discount 商家补贴率 40%：

blockquote.p: "This is not an exclusivity agreement — it's a zone invitation. Keeta is building a Sushi High-Quality Zone (Keeta Premier), with only 10 slots in the first batch.

You qualify and join (6 discounted dishes + 1 exclusive Premier Combo), and we give you: zone traffic slots + boosted recommendation to high-AOV users + platform subsidy + the 'Parceiro Premier Keeta' badge.
These resources iFood cannot give you. High-ticket, quality customers will only find you on Keeta Premier."
"这不是排他协议，是专区入驻。Keeta 在建 Sushi 高品质专区（Keeta Premier），首批只有 10 个名额。
你达标入驻（6 个折扣菜 + 1 个 Premier Combo 独家套餐），我们给你：专区流量位 + 高 AOV 用户精准推荐加权 + 平台补贴 + 'Parceiro Premier Keeta' 徽章。
这些资源 iFood 没法给你，高客单价的优质用户只在 Keeta Premier 找得到你。"
